info.title: tunit-report — merge TUnit test reports from multiple test projects into one.
info.description: Merges TUnit test report sidecars from multiple test projects, target frameworks or CI jobs into a single HTML report and GitHub Actions step summary.

options.name: --directory
options.description:
Directory scanned recursively for *.tunit-report.json
sidecars (written by TUnit next to each HTML report).

options.name: --output
options.description:
Path for the merged HTML report.
Default: <directory>/merged-report.html

options.name: --github-summary
options.description:
Also write the merged summary block to the file that
$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY points at (or stdout when unset).

options.name: --fail-on-failures
options.description: Exit with code 1 when any merged test failed.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help.
Exit codes: 0 success · 1 failures present (with --fail-on-failures) · 2 error.
